note: Facts published AFTER the 30-Sep-2026 as-of date. NOT used in the initiation; kept for the Q2FY27 update. Dates as reported by the sources (some approximate where the source shows relative timestamps).

facts.fact: PI unveiled Pioxaniliprole, India's first indigenously discovered insecticide molecule, after formal registration by the CIB&RC; brand launch reported as 'Pioxazon'. MD Mayank Singhal said 'global de-stocking has ended'; PI said it invested ~Rs 2,000 cr over 10-12 years in the molecule.

Q2FY27 (board meeting 4-Nov-2026): consolidated revenue Rs 17,018 mn (-9% YoY), EBITDA -57% (margin ~14% vs 29%), PAT Rs 1,222 mn (-70%). Domestic +19% (domestic biologicals +45%, global biologicals +250%).
Share price fell 19% on 5-Nov-2026 (NSE close Rs 1,770 from Rs 2,187; intraday low Rs 1,749.5), the lowest since Sep-2020.
Axis Direct: Buy, target Rs 2,750 (result update).
Citi negative view (90-day catalyst watch) after the weak Q2, citing pyroxasulfone exports and pricing.
Sep-2026 shareholding: promoter 46.09%, FIIs 14.79%, DIIs 31.39%, shareholders 146,689.
Trendlyne consensus on 16-Nov-2026: average target Rs 2,273.64, 'hold'; LTP Rs 1,711.80.
